ValidationRule.description: Keep the merchant reference and idempotency key stable across retries and callbacks.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Merchant_Reference__c), ISCHANGED(Idempotency_Key__c), ISCHANGED(Return_Request__c), ISCHANGED(Order_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Refund_Amount__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The return request, idempotency key, order, and amount cannot change after creation.
